notes.subject: קבלו
notes.rationale: Em i wanpela tok i stap long hia tasol long olgeta Tanakh — namba bilong masin bilong brukim banis.

notes.subject: בחרבותיו
notes.rationale: Ol man i tanim tok i no wankain: 'ol axe' (KJV, JPS) o 'ol bainat' (wok 'harava' i kam long mak bilong katim).

notes.subject: long Tsur
notes.rationale: Ves i toktok daun long taue bilong Tsur, narapela nem bilong em i no tok.

translation: Na ⟨em⟩ i wokim ol strik bilong masin brukim banis i go long ol banis bilong yu, na ⟨em⟩ i brukim daun ol taue bilong yu wantaim ol bainat bilong em.
